purpose: Prove that an isolated child can write, commit, push, and independently read back a synthetic durable result before any material delegation.
required_assertions: The child starts from controller commit containing this acceptance contract and its immutable task input.
The child writes only its declared owned subtree.
The canary payload exactly matches the nonce and content declared by the immutable task input.
The child emits a complete artifact manifest with SHA-256 and byte counts.
The child commits and pushes the result to its unique remote branch.
The controller or a distinct verifier reads every artifact back from the immutable result commit and independently verifies bytes and hashes.
Provider completion without a durable result commit is classified PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED.
Only the controller may record COMPLETED and the producer may not independently accept its own result.
